Saudi Toyota Championship

E-Gaming

Race beyond the track. Precision, strategy, and skill — powered by simulation.

Real competition. Virtual speed.

Digital Motorsport

Where VirtualRacing Gets Real.

The Saudi Toyota E-Gaming Championship brings drivers together on professional racing simulators designed to recreate the intensity and precision of real-world motorsport.

Competitors are tested on driving skill, race strategy, consistency, and control while competing under official racing regulations in a fair and professional environment.

The championship also creates a platform for discovering new talent and gives racing enthusiasts across the Kingdom an opportunity to compete, improve, and showcase their ability.
